sn55.24:1.2: Tena kho pana samayena Sarakāni sakko kālakato hoti
sn55.24:1.5: Tatra sudam sambahulā Sakkā saṅgamma samāgamma ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti ||
sn55.24:1.6: Acchariyam vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
sn55.24:1.8: yatra hi nāma Sarakāni sakko kālakato
sn55.24:1.11: Sarakāni sakko sikkhādubbalyam āpādi majjapānam apāyī ti || || 4.
sn55.24:2.1: Atha kho Mahānāmo sakko yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam nisīdi || ek- an- ni- kho Mahānamo sakko Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 5.
sn55.24:2.5: Tatra sudam bhante sambahulā Sakkā saṅgamma samāgamma ujjhāyanti bhīyanti vipācenti
sn55.24:2.6: Acchariyaṃ vata bho abbhutaṃ vata bho
sn55.24:2.8: yatra hi nāma Sarakāṇi sakko kālakato
sn55.24:2.11: Sarakāni sakko sikkhādubbalyam āpādi majjapānam apāyīti || ||
sn55.24:3.1: Yo so Mahānāma dīgharattam upāsako Buddhaṃ saraṇaṃ gato dhammaṃ sa- gato saṅghaṃ sa- gato kathaṃ vinipātam gaccheyya || || 6.
sn55.24:3.2: Yañ hi tam Mahānama sammāvadamāno vadeyya
sn55.24:3.3: Dīgharattam upāsako buddham- dhammam- saṅghaṃ- saraṇaṃ gato ti || Sarakānisakkaṃ sammāvadamāno vadeyya || ||
sn55.24:3.4: Sarakāni Mahānāma sakko dīgharattam upāsako Buddhaṃdhammaṃ- saṅghaṃ saraṇaṃ gato
sn55.24:4.1: Idha Mahānāma ekacco puggalo Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.24:4.2: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.24:4.6: So āsavanānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ cetovimuttim paññāvimuttim diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati ||
sn55.24:4.7: Ayam pi kho Mahānāma puggalo parimutto nirayā || parimutto tiracchānayoniyā || parimutto pittivisayā || parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā || || 8.
sn55.24:5.1: Idha pana Mahānāma ekacco puggalo Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.24:5.2: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.24:5.5: hāsapañño javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato || ||
sn55.24:5.6: So pañcannam orambhāgiyānam saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātiko hoti tattha parinibbāyī anāvattidhammo asmā lokā || ||
sn55.24:5.7: Ayam pi kho Mahānāma puggalo parimutto nirayā parimutto tiracchāyoniyā || parimutto pittivisayā || parimutto apāyaduggati vinipātā || || 9.
sn55.24:6.1: Idha pana Mahānāma ekacco puggalo Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.24:6.2: Iti pi so Bhagavā || la-pe || satthā devamanussānam buddho bhagavā ti ||
sn55.24:6.5: na hāsapañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato ||
sn55.24:6.6: so tiṇṇam saṃyojanānam parikkhayā rāgadosamohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmi hoti sakid eva imaṃ lokam āgantvā dukkhassantaṃ karoti || ||
sn55.24:6.7: Ayam pi kho Mahānāma puggalo parimutto nirayā parimutto tiracchānayoniyā || parimutto pittivisayā parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā || || 10.
sn55.24:7.1: Idha pana Mahānāma ekacco puggalo Buddhe aveccappasadena- ||
sn55.24:7.5: na hāsapañño na javanapañño na vimuttiyā samannāgato ||
sn55.24:7.6: so tiṇṇaṃ samyojanānam parikkhayā sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo sambodhiparāyano ti || ||
sn55.24:7.7: Ayam pi kho Mahānāma puggalo parimutto nirayā parimutto tiracchānayoniyā parimutto pittivisayā parimutto apāyaduggativinipātā || || 11.
sn55.24:8.1: Idha pana Mahānāma ekacco puggalo na heva kho Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.24:8.4: na hāsapañño na javanapañño na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato ||
sn55.24:8.7: tathāgatapaveditā cassa dhammā paññāya mattaso nijjhānaṃ khamanti || ||
sn55.24:8.8: Ayam pi kho Mahānāma puggalo agantā nirayaṃ agantā tiracchānayoniṃ agantā pittivisayam agantā apāyaduggativinipātaṃ || || 12.
sn55.24:9.1: Idha pana Mahānāma ekacco puggalo na heva kho Buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti ||
sn55.24:9.4: na hāsapañño na javanapañño || na ca vimuttiyā samannāgato ||
sn55.24:9.8: Ayam pi kho puggalo agantā nirayam agantā tiracchānayonim agantā pittivisayaṃ agantā apāyaduggativinipātaṃ || || 13.
sn55.24:9.9: Ime ce pi Mahānāma mahāsālā subhāsitaṃ dubbhāsitam ājāneyyuṃ || ime cāham mahāsāle vyākareyyaṃ Sotāpannā avinipātadhammā niyatā sambodhiparāyanā ti ||
sn55.24:9.11: Sarakāni Mahānāma sakko maraṇakāle sikkhaṃ samādiyī
